issue_context.title: cli: `\c` metacommand does not work in insecure mode
issue_context.body:
Filed upon request by @knz 

When running in insecure mode, switching the user with the `\c` CLI command doesn't work too well. E.g.

```
❯ ./cockroach sql --insecure
#
# Welcome to the CockroachDB SQL shell.
# All statements must be terminated by a semicolon.
# To exit, type: \q.
#
# Server version: CockroachDB CCL v21.2.0-alpha.00000000-2910-g701b177d8f (x86_64-apple-darwin20.6.0, built , go1.16.5) (same version as client)
# Cluster ID: ea4c23a1-5478-489f-a42b-880fc6e9b1cb
#
# Enter \? for a brief introduction.
#
root@:26257/defaultdb> \c - testuser
using new connection URL: postgresql://testuser@:26257/defaultdb
warning: error retrieving the transaction status: pq: SSL is not enabled on the server
warning: error retrieving the database name: pq: SSL is not enabled on the server
```

The problem seems to be that the `sslmode=disable` query param is not added
